name: AFX liquidity intermediary sweeps its swap helper's whole AFX balance and matches it from a funding wallet
summary: Function 0xb1a87f2c of intermediary 0x560d3973 swapped the caller's USDT to AFX into helper 0x671ce4, then took the helper's entire AFX balance instead of the swap output, refunded it to the caller and matched it with AFX and AHT pulled from funding wallet 0x146933f2 into the AFX/AHT pair. Donating AFX to the helper around a pool manipulation drained the wallet.
notes: Funding wallet 0x146933f2 approved the intermediary for AHT last of the three standing allowances (AFX at 71049553 and 71049565) the function draws on; the exploit needs them, so the AHT grant is the reset, 69 s after deployment.

AFX and AHT have no market price; together they are valued at the attackers' USDT proceeds at par (10,699.62 + 790.82, rule 15). The forced tokens became AFX/AHT liquidity at a manipulated ratio and were extracted through the AFX/USDT pair.
The intermediary is unverified; the balance-sweep logic is established from the exploit trace and BlockSec's analysis. 0x1ddfd1d2 (sender 0xf9572fa0) repeated it two days later.
